tagline: LADIFA: handmade Indonesian gemstone and handicraft collection from Setu, Tangerang Selatan.

story.title: Handmade gemstone and handicraft from Setu.
story.body: A public LADIFA website describes an Indonesia gemstone handmade handicraft collection based in Kademangan, Setu, Tangerang Selatan, accepting international orders. Because the TEI handover lists Ladifa Collection twice and the current project contact is still awaiting final social/marketplace details, the profile publishes the verified website identity while keeping the project-order channels marked pending.
